headline: US lawmakers propose expanded DUV chip tool export ban to China, escalating semiconductor trade war.
summary: A bipartisan US proposal seeks to block exports of DUV lithography and etching equipment to key Chinese firms like Huawei and SMIC, further intensifying the tech competition. This move would severely impede China's domestic chip manufacturing capabilities and deepen global supply chain decoupling, impacting semiconductor fabs and broader AI infrastructure development.
